task: Parse an AWS CloudWatch log entry and extract the timestamp, log level, and message. The log format is: '[TIMESTAMP] [LEVEL] MESSAGE'
solution_criteria: Regex pattern should correctly capture all three groups (timestamp, level, message) and work with ISO 8601 timestamps and standard log levels (INFO, ERROR, WARN, DEBUG)

task: Write a Python function that validates if an AWS S3 bucket name follows AWS naming conventions (3-63 characters, lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only, must start and end with letter or number)
solution_criteria: Function should return True/False, handle all edge cases, and use appropriate validation logic for all AWS S3 bucket naming rules

task: Create a JSON object representing an AWS IAM policy that allows read-only access to a specific S3 bucket 'my-data-bucket' and all its objects
solution_criteria: Valid IAM policy JSON with correct Version, Statement structure, proper Action array for s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket, correct Resource ARNs for both bucket and objects
